Package index

Predictions and forecasts

Predictive distributions from a fitted illume model, the rows a forecast needs, and covariates whose future is not known.

ilm_predict()
Predictive distributions from a fitted illume model
ilm_forecast()
Forecasts from a fitted illume model
ilm_future()
The rows a forecast will need: the next time points of every series
ilm_covariate_paths()
Draws of a covariate's future, from its own model
ilm_as_draws()
Covariate paths from another tool, as draws
as.data.frame(<ilm_pred>) summary(<ilm_pred>)
Point estimates and intervals from a predictive distribution

Totals and averages

Sums and weighted averages of predictions over rows, taken draw by draw.

ilm_aggregate()
Totals and averages of predictions over rows
ilm_average()
Weighted averages of predicted means: standardisation and post-stratification

Scores and calibration

How well predictive distributions match the outcomes: proper scores, scaled errors, probability integral transforms and calibration.

ilm_scores(<ilm_pred>)
Proper scores of a prediction against observed outcomes
ilm_naive_scale()
Each series' in-sample naive-forecast error, the scale of MASE and RMSSE
ilm_pit()
Probability integral transforms of observed outcomes
ilm_calibration(<ilm_pred>)
Calibration of a prediction against observed outcomes

Cross-validation and comparison

Folds that follow the data’s structure, cross-validated scores, and model comparisons with standard errors.

ilm_folds()
Cross-validation folds that follow the data's structure
ilm_cv()
Cross-validated scores of a fitted illume model
ilm_compare()
Compare models' predictive scores, with standard errors that respect the data

Plots

Fan charts, scores by horizon, model comparisons, PIT histograms and calibration.

ilm_plot_fan()
Fan chart of predictive distributions over time
ilm_plot_horizon()
Scores by forecast horizon
ilm_plot_compare()
Plot model comparisons with their intervals
ilm_plot_pit()
Histogram of probability integral transforms
ilm_plot_calibration()
Plot the calibration of predictive distributions

Extending limn

Methods a package defines so that limn can predict from, and refit, its own models.

ilm_cv_refit()
Refit a model to a fold's training rows
ilm_predict_draws()
The parameter draws behind a prediction
